_meta.description: Snapshot-style validation of the TUI's stable visual surfaces. Compares the pure-string renderers (format_status_line / format_spinner_line / render_entry_to_string) to golden expected text captured from claude-code's TSX renderers with the same input. The pure-string renderers are the same functions the iocraft components delegate to, so this locks the rendered text without driving an offscreen terminal. Color/style assertions are covered separately by the per-component unit tests; this fixture locks the text layer (markers, prefixes, separators, JSON preview spacing, truncation suffix).

user_text.body: what is the weather like in tokyo?
user_text.expected_rendered_text: > what is the weather like in tokyo?

assistant_text.body: It is sunny in Tokyo with a high of 24°C.
assistant_text.expected_rendered_text: ● It is sunny in Tokyo with a high of 24°C.
